primitives.name: Kinematic Alignment Scoring
primitives.verbatim_quote: Technical implementation encompasses pose detection algorithms, including YOLO-Pose and MoveNet, as well as motion comparison metrics such as cosine similarity and Dynamic Time Warping, and language model integration for generating personalized guidance.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'t': 'time index (dimensionless)', 'x_t': 'pose vector at time t (meters)', 'y_t': 'reference pose vector at time t (meters)', 'S': 'similarity score (dimensionless)'}
primitives.assumptions: Pose vectors are normalized; temporal alignment via DTW ensures comparable motion sequences.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When joint angle variance exceeds 15 degrees, cosine similarity becomes unreliable.

layer2.mapping: Maps real-time player pose to reference template via kernelized similarity function in GSI's probabilistic space.
layer2.telemetry: Normalized similarity score between current and reference stroke trajectory.

primitives.name: Style Matching Module
primitives.verbatim_quote: A supplementary module compares student techniques with those of professional athletes, identifying which ATP or WTA playing styles align most closely with individual form characteristics.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'p': 'professional athlete profile (dimensionless)', 'P': 'set of professional profiles (dimensionless)', 'v_i': 'student motion embedding (dimensionless)', 'w_p': 'professional motion embedding (dimensionless)', 'K': 'kernel similarity function (dimensionless)'}
primitives.assumptions: Motion embeddings are embedded in a shared latent space via clustering.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When student form deviates significantly from any cluster centroid, matching fails.

layer2.mapping: Isomorphically embeds student motion into professional style manifold via clustering and kernel regression in GSE.
layer2.telemetry: Match percentage indicating stylistic alignment with top N professionals.

primitives.name: Real-Time Feedback System
primitives.verbatim_quote: The platform extends beyond recorded session evaluation by offering live feedback capabilities through a specialized language model trained on annotated datasets of tennis biomechanics, functioning as an automated coaching assistant during practice.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'F': 'feedback vector (dimensionless)', 'x_t': 'current pose vector (meters)', 'y_{t-1}': 'previous pose vector (meters)', 'L': 'language model operator (dimensionless)', 'k': 'number of corrective actions (dimensionless)'}
primitives.assumptions: Feedback is generated from prior-to-current pose differences using a trained LLM.
primitives.breakdown_regime: If temporal gap exceeds 0.5 seconds, feedback latency causes misalignment.

layer2.mapping: Derives corrective action vector from difference kernel in GSI's temporal feedback space.
layer2.telemetry: Vector of posture adjustment recommendations per stroke phase.
